## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the final behavior, and the responsible skill or composition. English or Simplified Chinese is welcome.

## Validation

List the actual commands and results, relevant synthetic/scenario checks, and any unverified host behavior. Content-only changes do not require a new test suite.

## Review points

- [ ] Source files and generated skills are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] Existing/new project gates, end-specific rules, and conditional stages remain consistent.
- [ ] All six READMEs were updated if shared overview facts changed.
- [ ] Sources and license scope are documented; no private content or local machine paths were added.

## Remaining gaps

State relevant limitations or follow-up work. Use “None identified” only within the scope actually reviewed.
